name: Release v0.9.12
body:
Hey there! We've been busy making Autohand better. Here's what's new since v0.9.11:

### A calmer full-screen terminal

- The transcript no longer jumps up and down while a turn runs or a message is sent. Rows that are replaced mid-turn hold their place instead of collapsing and reopening.
- Drag across transcript text to select it; the selection is highlighted and copied when you release. The highlight no longer depends on detected colour support.
- Click a command or tool result to expand it, and click again to collapse it.
- Chat history is inset two columns from the window edge. The composer, menus, tip and status line stay on the edge at full width.
- Resuming a session replays each turn once, the way it was shown live, instead of printing tool narration again.

### Honest turn outcomes

- A turn you stop with Esc is reported as interrupted, not failed, in the footer, the tool row, stop hooks (`HOOK_TURN_OUTCOME=interrupted`), RPC and ACP (`cancelled`).
- A turn whose answer was delivered but whose Moa checkpoint review is unresolved now reads "Needs review" instead of "Failed". Stop hooks receive `needs_review`, and ACP ends the turn normally instead of raising an internal error. The work still does not count as approved.
- A turn that changed no files is reviewed even when the workspace already holds a large uncommitted change. Turns that did change files, and commits, keep the diff limit.

### Sessions, lanes and memory

- `/agents` is a session command center: sessions grouped by project, filter tabs, a details pane, and Enter to switch session and working directory. Keyboard and mouse both work. The previous live view is `/agents --live`.
- Experimental: ask Autohand to "open a new lane" to run a named background agent on one task while you keep working. Lanes are listed under the composer. Enable with `autohand experiments enable cli_lanes`; see `docs/cli-lanes.md`.
- `/memories` opens a settings screen with "Use memories", "Generate memories" and a local reset. `agent.useMemories` controls whether stored memories reach the model.
- `/usage` charts are selectable with the mouse and show the skills that were used.

### Commands that show their result

- `/permissions`, `/memory` and `/discovery` print their output in the full-screen transcript. `/discovery` says what it is scanning and why it failed when it does.
- A script that calls a tool that does not exist is told which tools are closest, and how to run a program such as `git` through `run_command`.
- The status line follows `/model` changes and shows the same account plan as `/status`.

### Providers, language and mobile

- LLM Gateway requests work again: the gateway had started rejecting the source tag the CLI sent.
- Replies stay in the language set by `ui.locale`, English included. A remembered language preference no longer overrides it, and reply-language preferences are no longer saved as memories.
- A run that stops at a limit you set with `--max-requests`, `--max-tokens`, `--max-duration` or `agent.budget` is no longer reported as a bug.
- Pair the current session with the native mobile app using `/mobile`, `/mobile(ios)`, `/mobile(android)`, `/ios` or `/android`. Native iOS is available first.

### Updates

- Expect the inset banner in the tmux startup terminal test
- Prepare Autohand Code 0.9.12
- Route mobile platform aliases through the existing pairing relay
- Keep replies in the configured language
- Do not file a run that reached its own budget as a bug
- Send LLM Gateway a source tag it accepts
- Report an unresolved Moa review as needing review, not as a failed turn
- Review a turn that changed no files despite earlier uncommitted work
- Document transcript selection and click behaviour in full-screen mode
- Keep the composer and footer on the window edge in full screen
- Submit discovery terminal scenarios only after the composer shows the line
- Say what /discovery is doing and why it failed
- Inset the full-screen interface two columns from the window edge
- Show /memory output and add the /memories settings screen
- Add lanes behind the cli_lanes experiment
- Make /usage charts selectable and show the skills that were used
- Turn /agents into a session command center
- Show /permissions output in the full-screen transcript
- Show the transcript selection without relying on detected colour
- Tell a script how to run a program it called as a tool
- Report a turn the user stopped as interrupted, not failed
- Keep the full-screen transcript still while a turn runs
- Select transcript text and open the tool result that was clicked
- Stop teaching run_tool_script a tool that does not exist
- Replay a resumed session the way the turn was shown live
- Fix status line model display and account plan label consistency

Full comparison: https://github.com/autohandai/code-cli/compare/v0.9.11...v0.9.12

---

### Get it

**Quickest way:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://autohand.ai/install.sh | sh
```

**Via npm or bun:**
```bash
npm install -g autohand-cli
```

**Via Homebrew:**
```bash
brew install autohandai/code/autohand-code
```

**Or grab a binary below** for your platform.

| Platform | Architecture | Binary |
|----------|--------------|--------|
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `autohand-macos-arm64` |
| macOS | Intel | `autohand-macos-x64` |
| Linux | x64 | `autohand-linux-x64` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `autohand-linux-arm64` |
| Windows | x64 | `autohand-windows-x64.exe` |
| Windows | ARM64 | `autohand-windows-arm64.exe` |

name: Alpha v0.9.9-alpha.8d046f0
body:
> **Alpha Release** - This is a pre-release build from the latest `main` branch. It may contain bugs or incomplete features.

Hey there! We've been busy making Autohand better. Here's what's new since v0.9.9-alpha.4597ad0:

No code changes were found in this comparison range.

Full comparison: https://github.com/autohandai/code-cli/compare/v0.9.9-alpha.4597ad0...v0.9.9-alpha.8d046f0

---

### Get it

**Install this alpha build:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://autohand.ai/install.sh | sh -s -- --alpha
```

**Or install the latest stable release:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://autohand.ai/install.sh | sh
```

**Or grab a binary below** for your platform.

| Platform | Architecture | Binary |
|----------|--------------|--------|
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `autohand-macos-arm64` |
| macOS | Intel | `autohand-macos-x64` |
| Linux | x64 | `autohand-linux-x64` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `autohand-linux-arm64` |
| Windows | x64 | `autohand-windows-x64.exe` |
| Windows | ARM64 | `autohand-windows-arm64.exe` |

### macOS alpha signing

These macOS alpha binaries and the Computer Use app are ad-hoc signed, not notarized by Apple.
Downloaded apps may require **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445).
Computer Use may require Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions again after updates.
